summary.text: Donnie Chesteen, a Republican, has represented Alabama Senate District 29 since November 7, 2018, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He previously served in the Alabama House of Representatives, District 87, from 2010 to 2018.
He earned B.S. and M.S. degrees in physical education from Troy University.
His professional experience includes work as a high school teacher, football coach and athletic director, and as a medical sales representative for Mead Johnson.
